title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: Days-Supply Points on Kestrel Rx Savings Club Generic Prices
content:
Days-supply points on the Kestrel Rx Savings Club price of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs are set by the days supply dispensed on the fill: **84 days or more** add **3 percentage points**, **31 to 83 days** add **1 percentage point**, and **30 days or fewer** add none.

The points are percentage points added to the discount percentage by which the usual and customary price of a generic fill sold for cash is reduced; they concern a generic that is not on the Kestrel Value Generics list, and a brand fill takes none. The discount percentage and the percentage points added to it make one total percentage: the usual and customary price is reduced once by that total percentage and rounded to the cent half up, and the percentages never act one after another. The days supply is the days supply dispensed that the Prescriptions fill ledger shows on the fill being priced.

| Days supply dispensed on the fill | Days-supply points |
|---|---|
| 1 to 30 | 0 |
| 31 to 83 | 1 |
| 84 or more | 3 |

## Edges of each band (hypothetical fills)

| Days supply | Points | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 0 | 30 days or fewer |
| 31 | 1 | first day of the 31-to-83 band |
| 83 | 1 | last day of the 31-to-83 band |
| 84 | 3 | 84 days or more |
| 90 | 3 | 84 days or more |
